verdict.rationale: Brex's product docs explicitly describe auto-blocking out-of-policy purchases with preset rules and limits, auto-enforced spend controls, and a Budgets/Spend Limits API for programmatic control, matching the finance-lead story of restricting and declining spend by policy. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of category/merchant-level rule granularity and independent/hands-on confirmation that point-of-sale declines work as described in practice.
